### Temperature vs. Month at Alaska Allen Army Airfield

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4 }
#load necessary libraries 
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

allen_army_1945_2019 <- readRDS("allen_army_1945_2019.rds")

# Create month variables
part1 <- allen_army_1945_2019 %>% 
  mutate( month = month(time, label = TRUE)) 

#Create boxplots of temperature by month
ggplot(part1, aes(x = month, y = temp)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "bisque")+
  xlab("Month of Year") + ylab("Temperature (Celsius)")

```

Above is a collection of boxplots of temperatures by month for the Allen Army Airfield meteorological dataset in Alaska. It covers 
`r range(year(part1$time))[2]-range(year(part1$time))[1]` years from `r  range(year(part1$time))[1]` to `r  range(year(part1$time))[2]`.
